push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.6 (5th best match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.6 is your 5th best match performance. Right up there with your very best.

DID WELL
+ A goal against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Cool as the other side of the pillow.
+ 1 assist. Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ That link with tuxedo_slide was smoother than a Cadillac on new pavement.
+ 0.7 over your norm. Keep stacking days like this.
+ That 8.6 sits as your 5th best match performance. Lovely stuff.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted. For next time: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. You know you can.
- Heads up, you and tuxedo_slide: defensive work rate. Simple fix: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 2 misplaced passes took 0.1. Clean that up next time.

Practice prescription: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

Remember, BellyTb1: Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

Good game, great person, bright future. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.detail: 8/14 passes (57%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

weaknesses.detail: 14 passes but no key passes - plenty of the ball, little going forward
weaknesses.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
weaknesses.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it.

push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.5 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.5. You played like someone who read the playbook twice and highlighted it.

DID WELL
+ 14 passes (down from your usual 16). High involvement, high impact.
+ A brace against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Defenders can draw up all the plans they want; you just scored anyway.
+ 1.0 above your usual rating. That's growth, and growth is the whole point.
+ 8.5: your 2nd best match performance. Remember how that felt.
+ 2 shots on target: +0.1 to your rating. Keep stacking those.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Start here: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into. Next match, nail it.
- 57% passing (8 of 14). Think about this: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. That's how good becomes great.
- No key passes from 14 passes. Here's the deal: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side. Feet first, then flair.
- defensive work rate needs work from you and BellyTb1. Easy plan: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 3 shots off target dropped you 0.1. Let's patch that.

Work on: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

tuxedo_slide, one more thing before you log off: Your feet are only as fast as your eyes. Look first.

Keep being you. - Coach Lasso
